purpose: Audit and upgrade AXIGNAL cinematic Globe rendering quality, regional LOD, adaptive Canvas resolution, asset rights and R3F performance without duplicating GSAP choreography.
inputs: The active AXIGNAL task, Goal Lock, governing contracts and current working tree.
The existing Globe Canvas, R3F scene, GSAP progress source and responsive behavior.
Texture sources, derivatives, dimensions, checksums, rights basis and encoder state.
Measured WebGL capabilities, Canvas dimensions, performance and visual references.
outputs: A capability-selected texture tier and measurable Canvas rendering contract.
A reversible regional LOD pipeline with runtime state and fallback telemetry.
Independent geographic boundaries and a resource-safe R3F implementation.
Deterministic technical gates plus comparable visual evidence for human review.
prohibited_actions: Replace the investigationCinematic timeline, its canonical labels, pin, scrub, responsive or reduced-motion behavior.
Add an unpinned texture encoder, private registry, secret or runtime dependency.
Download, hotlink or ship an asset without explicit provenance and rights basis.
Use a poster, giant PNG or prerecorded animation as the healthy WebGL experience.
Claim physical-GPU performance or human visual acceptance without measured evidence.

tests.description: The Skill passes the Codex Skill structure and frontmatter validator.
The deterministic WebGL auditor accepts the required pipeline and rejects missing LOD or fallback isolation.
The typed Skill contract validates against schemas/skill.schema.json.
The landing passes deterministic texture, LOD, DPR, vector-boundary, poster and telemetry checks.

deactivation.kill_switch: Set the registry state to REVOKED and route Globe rendering tasks to globe-engineer while preserving axignal-gsap-ui-ux.
deactivation.rollback: Revert this Skill directory and registry entries; do not revert the independent GSAP Skill.
